posts.content:
Project Overview

Our team installed a 65-inch Samsung S95H OLED and a Bose soundbar above a stone-faced fireplace. The important part of this project was the structure behind the decorative finish: both pieces needed support at the mounting position. We supplied a Sanus 4D Advanced mount and brought the screen and soundbar together above the mantel.

Installation Details

We located two wood studs behind the stone and attached both the television and soundbar to those studs. The completed arrangement places the display and audio together while retaining the stone surround as the backdrop.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

An 85-inch television and soundbar made this fireplace installation a two-person job. Our team mounted the Neo QLED above the brick mantel using a Sanus 4D Advanced mount that we supplied. The large screen and soundbar were positioned together within the fireplace wall, giving the room one combined viewing and listening setup.

Installation Details

The brick surface required masonry drill bits and anchors for the mounting work. We prepared the bracket position on the painted brick, then fitted the television and soundbar above the mantel. The work combined large-screen handling with the requirements of a masonry mounting surface.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

This fireplace project brought together a 77-inch LG W6, recessed connection space and mounting for a Sonos Arc Ultra. Our team prepared the wall for the display and soundbar arrangement, with the television fitted close to the fireplace wall. The finished side profile keeps the screen close to the surface without leaving the connection equipment to determine the fit.

Installation Details

A recessed media box provides space behind the display for its connections. The wireless LG Zero Connect Box remains in the same room, while the Sonos Arc Ultra has its own mounting provision below the television.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

For this 85-inch Samsung Frame TV, we used a Sanus Preferred full-motion mount on a drywall wall with wood studs behind it. Our team prepared the mounting position and fitted the large display to the adjustable bracket. The result gives the screen movement away from the wall, as well as a position closer to the wall when that is preferred.

Installation Details

The wood studs provided the supporting structure behind the drywall. The extended side view shows how the mount carries the television away from the wall; the front view shows the screen returned to its wall-mounted position.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

Our team installed a 65-inch Samsung Frame Pro above a fireplace and connected it to the home’s existing Sonos equipment. The project involved both the television’s fit against the wall and its connection to an audio component located elsewhere in the house. We brought those parts together without changing the fireplace’s role as the room’s central feature.

Installation Details

We replaced the regular outlet with a recessed outlet to provide clearance behind the television. The screen was also connected to a Sonos Amp in the basement, integrating the new display with the existing audio setup.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

This room already had in-wall speakers, and our task was to bring a 100-inch LG QNED84B into that setup. We positioned the television centrally between the speakers and installed it on a Sanus static mount. The large screen now sits within the existing speaker layout, bringing the picture and the room’s audio system into the same viewing area.

Installation Details

Our team connected the television to the home audio system. The static mount provides a fixed screen position, with the installation centered on the wall between the existing speakers.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

A close wall fit was the key consideration for this 65-inch Samsung Frame Pro. Our team mounted the television on the textured wall and addressed the power connection behind it. The existing outlet and cord arrangement needed adjustment so those connections would take up less space between the display and the wall.

Installation Details

We replaced the regular outlet with a recessed outlet and supplied a different power cord to reduce the remaining gap. Those changes provided the clearance needed for the mounted Frame Pro to sit closer to the wall.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

Our team installed an 85-inch Sony BRAVIA together with a Sonos Arc Ultra soundbar. The project required a different approach to the connection space behind the screen because the wall was already occupied by other building services. We mounted the television and soundbar and concealed the cables running between them, bringing the two components together as one wall-mounted setup.

Installation Details

Plumbing and air-conditioning pipes prevented the use of a recessed media box at this location. The installation therefore focused on the mounting arrangement and the TV-to-soundbar cable connection, rather than adding a box inside the occupied wall space.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

The connection layout behind this 77-inch LG G6 shaped the installation. Our team fitted a Legrand recessed media box and positioned it toward the left side of the television, following the location of the HDMI inputs. This gave the connections space behind the display while supporting the close-to-wall Gallery setup.

Installation Details

The box and mounting plate had to work together within the area covered by the screen. By aligning the recessed connection space with the television’s input layout, we kept that equipment behind the display and allowed the mounted LG G6 to sit close to the wall.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

Our team paired a 55-inch Samsung OLED with a MantelMount MAX1 above a tiled fireplace. The project required attention to the tiled mounting surface, the mount’s weight and the positions the screen would occupy. We prepared the mounting location, fitted the MAX1 assembly and installed the television above the fireplace.

Installation Details

The completed setup allows the screen to move between a raised position above the mantel and a lower viewing position. Both positions are part of the finished arrangement, with the mounting assembly providing the movement shown in the raised and lowered views.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

Our team installed a 77-inch LG C6 with a Samsung Q990H soundbar system, combining the screen and audio in one wall-mounted arrangement. The work included the connections between the two components as well as space for the power equipment behind the television. Keeping those elements together was central to the installation.

Installation Details

We concealed the cables between the television and soundbar and used a recessed box for the outlet and surge protector. This provided connection space behind the display while keeping the interconnecting cables out of view below the screen.

Project Gallery

Project Overview

Installing this 77-inch LG G6 above a stone-veneer fireplace required preparation of both the mounting surface and the space behind the screen. Our team worked with the stone finish using diamond drill bits and a diamond grinder disc, making provision for the mounting hardware and the recessed equipment.

Installation Details

A media box houses the outlet, surge protector and Apple TV behind the television. Recessing those components provides clearance for the LG G6 to sit close to the stone surface. The completed arrangement keeps the display above the fireplace with its supporting equipment behind it.

Installation Gallery

Project Overview

Our team installed an 85-inch Samsung Neo QLED on a plain interior wall in Evanston. The large display becomes the focus of the wall without a freestanding support beneath the screen. A recessed media box and concealed wiring provide connection space behind the television. The completed wall-mounted arrangement keeps the screen’s front view uncluttered, with the power and connection equipment behind the display.

Project Overview

Our team completed this wall-mounted television installation in Wilmette. We worked at the chosen mounting position and fitted the display against the interior wall. The finished setup gives the television a defined place in the room, with a clear view of the screen and no visible support legs. The project video follows the work at the wall and shows the mounted television.

Installation Video

Project Overview

Our team mounted an outdoor television and soundbar on a brick wall in Glenview. The setup sits beneath a covered outdoor area, with horizontal privacy slats above the screen and brick around the mounting position. Placing the television on the wall keeps it off the deck and gives the patio a dedicated viewing point. The completed arrangement brings television and audio into the covered outdoor space.

Project Overview

Our team mounted a Samsung Frame TV on the tiled wall above a linear fireplace. The display sits within the large, pale tiles, with a soundbar directly beneath it. The television, audio and fireplace form one vertical arrangement, while the surrounding tile remains visible around the screen. The completed installation brings the display into the fireplace wall without adding a separate television stand.

Installation video
